pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, polygonal dark regions with irregular, serrated edge gradients. Patch area is maximal along the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more concentrated shapes on the shoulder and lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a complex topological mesh. Nodes typically consist of three-way junctions with relatively uniform pixel thickness, becoming slightly wider at the ventral boundary.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-textured, low-amplitude serrated profile along the neck ridge. The mane presents as a continuous, dense silhouette against the foliage background.
